svg.aria-label: SciPy methods illustrated with this chapter’s 25 teaching observations: A and b re-solved at fixed τ=2, 3, and 5 s, pointwise residuals, and their sum of squares. The lower-right profile re-solves both linear coefficients at every τ; the star marks the bounded curve_fit result. SciPy connects these array and function operations to reusable numerical algorithms.
